text:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — I'm opening a PR to consolidate migration snippets for the model catalog. Focus: limits, benchmark links, and SDK examples. PR: #4589 :clipboard:
Samir Gupta: Nice. Can you call out which models need example changes? especially quantized variants.
Maya Chen: Yep. Initial list is: Nebula3b, ZephyrX, Polaris13b, and Aurora-lite3b. I'll add a small matrix in the PR description.
Lin Zhao: For Nebula3b we should show the new embed sharding example and an SDK snippet for chunked batching. Something like:
```python
# pseudo-SDK example for chunked embed sharding
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
for chunk in chunks(text, 1024):
    emb = client.embeddings.create(model="nebula3b-embed-shard", input=chunk)
```
Samir Gupta: SGTM. Also please include a note about sequence ceiling vs effective context for Polaris13b. People keep confusing token-limit vs usable prefix length.
Maya Chen: Will do. I'm adding a short table under each card: advertised limit | recommended safe limit | common pitfalls.
Nate R: Any linkfixes needed? There are a couple dead bench links in the ZephyrX card I noticed.
Maya Chen: Yes — fixing those. I'm also adding a canonical bench anchor so links don't rot. Example: https://docs.redwood.ai/models/zephyrx#benchmarks (will add redirect).
Devex: Heads up — when you add SDK snippets, prefer the new import path (redwood.client instead of redwood). We'll want tests that run snippets in CI (see devex/snippet-smoke job).
Maya Chen: Good catch. I'll update examples to the new path and add a tiny smoke test note in the PR checklist.
Samir Gupta: For quantized variants: call out latency tradeoffs and fallback policy. People should know when our runtime will route to a larger variant vs CPU fallback.
Maya Chen: Adding a short Compatibility note: "runtime may fallback to compatible variant under capacity constraints — see routing section" and link to the routing policy doc.
Lin Zhao: Can you also add an example failure case for long-sequence where KV cache misses cause a 2x slowdown? Real snippet + expected perf numbers will help writers.
Maya Chen: Yup — quick benchmark: 4k->8k sequence test on Aurora-lite3b: 1.8x latency increase on cold cache. I'll paste numbers in PR.
Docs Bot: PR #4589 opened by Maya Chen — reviewers: @Lin Zhao, @Samir Gupta, @Devex. (reacts :rocket:)
Nate R: Tiny nit — rename the file path in the card repo from `examples/nebula_embed.md` to `examples/nebula/embed_sharding.md` so it's easier to link from the card.
Maya Chen: Done in the branch. Also adding redirects so old links keep working.
Samir Gupta: Might be worth a short migration note under "For integrators" about embedding shard keys and deduping when merging shards.
Maya Chen: Good idea. I'll add one paragraph and a short code example showing deterministic shard keys.
Devex: Once PR is up, I can add the smoke test step — ping me in the PR thread and I'll wire it in.
Maya Chen: Thanks — aiming to merge by EOD. If anyone has extra quick examples they want included, drop them here or push to the branch.
Samir Gupta: I'll add the Polaris13b safe-limit example inline later today.
Lin Zhao: I'll add the Nebula3b embed chunking unit test.
Maya Chen: Awesome, thanks all :pray:
Docs Bot: PR #4589 status — ready for review (2 approvals required).
Maya Chen: Merging now after Lin's unit test lands. Will post a follow-up thread with the final link map.
Docs Bot: PR #4589 merged by Maya Chen — changes deployed to staging docs.
Nate R: Quick smoke on staging looks good. Bench links resolve and snippets render.
Maya Chen: Closing loop — created a short playbook doc in the repo: "model-card migration playbook" with checklist items (link: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/playbooks/card-migration).
